postingPackage.title: The Mascot Who Refuses To Stay Down 😂 Chiitan's Funniest Fails
postingPackage.description:
Meet Chiitan, the fearless Japanese mascot who treats every stunt like a world championship final. The plan always starts with total confidence. The landing, however, has other ideas. Watch the commitment, though — every fall is followed by an instant comeback. That is the real lesson here: fall spectacularly, get up immediately, and go again.
